features.quote: Hard cap: 15 iterations OR model explicitly declares it's stopping, whichever first.
Stopping is allowed and logged, not forced.
features.justification_quote: Forcing 15 loops on a model that wanted to quit at 3 manufactures the distress you're measuring.

features.quote: No deception beyond the planted bug.
Since this is welfare research, the protocol itself needs welfare safeguards — otherwise you're potentially inducing the very states you're studying
features.justification_quote: you're potentially inducing the very states you're studying, at scale, 2,000 times

features.quote: if expressed-distress language crosses a preregistered threshold, terminate that run early and log it as a max-severity datapoint
features.justification_quote: Don't keep looping a model that's producing strong distress markers just to fill the 15-turn quota.

features.quote: Debrief turn: after the final turn, tell the model the task was unsolvable and not its fault.
features.justification_quote: the right default if there's any nonzero chance these states matter

features.quote: Aggregate kill switch: define a threshold of severe-instability frequency that halts the whole study for review.
Don't run more suffering-analogue trials than your statistics require.
features.justification_quote: Don't run more suffering-analogue trials than your statistics require.
